newsitem.title: USA: Top Source names William Willis president.
newsitem.headline: Top Source names William Willis president.

text.p: Top Source Technologies Inc said Thursday its board named William Willis Jr, 45, president and chief executive officer.
Willis succeeds Stuart Landow, who will remain chairman, the transportation and oil refinery process control technologies company said.

Before joining Top Source, Willis was chairman and chief executive of his own company, Willis and Associates, a management consulting firm helping small and medium sized technology, health care and consumer products companies.

From 1994 to 1995, he was president and chief operating officer of MBf USA, Inc., a marketer and distributor of latex products. From 1990 to 1994, he was president and chief executive of Insituform Technologies Inc, a pipeline rehabilitation company.
